title: Hearty Healthy Japanese Buckwheat Noodles
description: A sweet and flaky Japanese dish featuring buckwheat noodles, perfect for a sick day, made with a tandoor and vegetarian friendly ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the buckwheat noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Stir in the tandoor spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil, and pour the sauce over the mushroom mixture.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Season with salt to taste, and garnish with chopped green onions.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
